pending_tasks.name: hybrid-llama4-scout-minilm-l6-boost2
pending_tasks.description: Evaluate hybrid search combining Llama-4-Scout-17B candidates with fast ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 cross-encoder reranking and grade-boost 2.0 to maximize efficiency.
pending_tasks.reasoning: Recent campaign iterations focused almost exclusively on the LLM family, leaving non-LLM methods untested despite having significant room for efficiency and accuracy gains. For the non-LLM task, we evaluate the lexical engine with `--engine filtered`, which suppresses restaurant-level context matches when query terms already appear in item-level text, directly tackling false-positive drift on cuisine terms. For the second task, we pair the newly generated Llama-4-Scout-17B candidates (which led to 0.8701 NDCG@5 with bge-reranker-v2-m3) with the much faster `cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2` reranker and grade-boost 2.0, hypothesizing that lower reranking latency combined with Scout's candidate recall will set a new benchmark record for efficiency.
